test_channel_close_immediately_after_cal: test that closing a gRPC channel immediately after invoking a stream-stream call returns CANCELLED status
test_channel_close_while_call_active: test that closing a gRPC channel while a streaming call is active cancels the response iterator
test_context_manager_channel_close: test that exiting a gRPC channel context manager cancels all active streaming calls
test_concurrent_channel_closes: test that many concurrent channel close calls do not cause deadlocks or crashes
review_Pipe_class: review the Pipe class which provides a thread-safe condition-variable-backed iterator for streaming test data
